# dsh-req-capture
Diagnostic plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). It wraps the host's global `fetch` to log outgoing req
uests and capture matching request bodies to disk for offline analysis (for example, diffing LLM req
uest payloads when debugging cache-hit differences).
No UI, no tools.
## Configuration
| env | meaning | default |
| `REQ_CAPTURE_MATCH` | URL substring; bodies of requests whose URL contains it are written to the c

apture dir | empty (capture nothing, log only) |
| `REQ_CAPTURE_DIR` | capture directory | `/tmp/dsh

pty (capture nothing, log only) |
| `REQ_CAPTURE_DIR` | capture directory | `/tmp/dsh-req-capture` |
Every fetch call is logged to `<dir>/fetch-log.txt` (timestamp, method, truncated URL, body size); m
atching bodies are written as `req-<ts>-<seq>.json`. A self-probe fetch runs once on apply to verify
the wrapper is live in the host realm.
> **Warning** — captured bodies are raw request payloads and may contain prompt content. Treat the c
apture directory as sensitive and delete it when done.
## Install
Install it from the **DSH Plugin Market** (Settings → Plugin Market), or add it to your profile bund
le stack manually — see `cordis.patch.yml`. Prebuilt; no build step required.
